canonical_project: SMART Sierra Leone national data centres (Government of Sierra Leone / China deal)
owner: Government of Sierra Leone; China National Technical Import & Export Corporation
notes: US$50m SMART Sierra Leone agreement (Sep 2024) includes establishing national data centers to manage/protect sovereign data and securing critical state infrastructure in Freetown. Exact sites and capacities not disclosed; assigned to Western Area because of the Freetown infrastructure reference. Pipeline/planned - no official commissioning or construction evidence yet.
